name: India Alliance Intermediate Fellowship in Basic Biomedical Research
amount: Personal salary up to Rs 13.8 lakh/year + research funds up to Rs 3.6 crore + collaboration and travel funds
other_rules: need not be resident in India when applying but must relocate to and work in India
hypothesis-driven proposal answering an original biomedical research question within India Alliance remit
Intermediate usually suits 4-7 years post-PhD (overall SIF window 4-15 years)
not-for-profit host institution in India and a sponsor there who guarantees space and resources
notes: Deadline shown is the 2026 preliminary-application round (23 Mar 2026, from a university listing); the next call is not yet announced. Process: preliminary application on IASys, then invited full application with international peer review, then interview. Salary and grant figures come from the ISTI government summary (last updated 2021) because the India Alliance page could not be read automatically; confirm current amounts. No salaried host position required; salary top-up if host already pays a salary. Needs at least one recommendation letter and an official sponsor support letter at full-application stage.
